facts.fact: e-GA's legal officer says section 28(e) of the e-Government Act No. 10 of 2019 directs public institutions to create a friendly environment for delivering e-government services to people with special needs, including the Deaf.

e-GA says citizens can obtain various government services through the mGov mobile system by dialling *152*00#, and a CHAVITA board member says it let Deaf people pay electricity and water bills by phone.

systems.country_label: Mfumo wa Huduma za Serikali kupitia Simu ya Mkononi (mGov)

TZA.note: Only a page-header mention of e-GA's own ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 certificates, which place nothing.
The document cites the e-Government Act only for its accessibility duty and says nothing of data sharing.
The document presents e-GA's systems to the Deaf but does not state who built or runs them.
Nothing on a national standards body, a national IT standard or certification in the country.
